description:
Prevent the site from returning to copy, route, version, and proof drift.

Exit criteria:
- CI protects links, placeholders, Livebooks, claims, terminology, search, sitemap, and Skills.
- Executable pages have owners, versions, and validation dates.
- The team measures user success, not only page traffic.
- Content and package drift create assigned backlog work.
- CI proves the allowed path, denied path, durable history, trace continuity, and redaction for the operational-control example.
- Restricted control, security, and compliance language cannot publish without qualified evidence.

Backlog tasks: 50

Source: Jido Site Improvement Backlog 2026-07-23.md
title: E12 — Automate quality, freshness, and measurement
